news.title: Samoskevich scores twice and Kraken beat Flames 6-1 in home opener as Calgary stays winless
news.ruTitle: Самоскевич забивает дважды, а Кракен обыграл «Флэймз» со счетом 6:1 в первом домашнем матче, а «Калгари» остается без побед
news.description: — Berkly Catton, Mackie Samoskevich and Bobby McMann scored within the first eight minutes of the game and the Seattle Kraken cruised to a 6-1 win over the Calgary Flames on Sunday night.

news.title: Mikael Granlund scores in OT, Cutter Gauthier gets 2 goals in Ducks' 3-2 win over Panthers
news.ruTitle: Микаэль Гранлунд забивает в овертайме, Каттер Готье забивает 2 гола в победе «Дакс» над «Пантерс» со счетом 3:2.
news.description: — Cutter Gauthier scored two power-play goals and captain Mikael Granlund had a power-play goal 4:14 into overtime, sending the Anaheim Ducks to a 3-2 victory over the Florida Panthers on Sunday night...

news.title: Marchand, out since March 6, scores in return to Panthers
news.ruTitle: Маршан, выбывший из игры с 6 марта, забивает в ответ на "Пантеры"
news.description: Florida Panthers forward Brad Marchand, out since March 6, made his season debut Sunday night against the Anaheim Ducks following an offseason that included surgery for the 38-year-old left wing, who scored 27 goals last season.

news.title: Shesterkin makes 28 saves and has an assist as Rangers beat Mammoth 4-2 for 3rd straight win
news.ruTitle: Шестеркин сделал 28 сейвов и сделал результативную передачу, когда «Рейнджерс» обыграли «Мамонта» со счетом 4–2 и одержали третью победу подряд.
news.description: — Igor Shesterkin made 28 saves and had an assist on Eeli Tolvanen's empty-net goal with 1:15 remaining and the New York Rangers beat the Utah Mammoth 4-2 on Sunday night.

news.title: Kyle Connor scores a pair of power-play goals as Jets squeak past Red Wings 3-2
news.ruTitle: Кайл Коннор забивает пару голов в большинстве, когда «Джетс» обыгрывают «Ред Уингз» со счетом 3–2.
news.description: — Kyle Connor scored two of Winnipeg's three power-play goals and added an assist on the third as the Jets held off the Detroit Red Wings 3-2 on Sunday.

news.title: Sabres F Kulich returns from blood clot issues, nets winner
news.ruTitle: Сэйбрс Ф. Кулич возвращается после проблем с тромбами, победитель по воротам
news.description: Nearly a year of worries of whether he was ever going to play again, while he recovered from a blood clot issue, washed away as Buffalo Sabres forward Jiri Kulich scored the go-ahead goal with 6:40 left to secure a 4-3 victory over the Chicago Blackhawks.
